title: Evidence-Grounded Trustworthy Multimodal Reasoning and Evaluation Benchmark in Complex Urban Scenes
abstract: arXiv:2506.09557v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) demonstrate impressive performance in benign scenarios, their cognitive reliability deteriorates significantly in complex scenes under adverse conditions. In these settings, models often rely on implicit inference without sufficient visual evidence, leading to a disconnect between perception and reasoning. Meanwhile, existing outcome-oriented benchmarks evaluate only final predictions and fail to diagnose failures in the underlying reasoning process. To address this gap, the authors propose AD2-Bench, which introduces a Hierarchical Visual Diagnosis framework that decomposes reasoning into a structured Chain of Evidence (CoE). This fine-grained diagnosis reveals that robust multimodal reasoning fundamentally depends on accurate evidence acquisition. Building on this perspective, the authors formulate reasoning from a probabilistic viewpoint and identify two primary causes of reason

translated_title: 复杂城市场景中基于证据的可信多模态推理与评估基准
translated_abstract: 尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在良性场景中展现出令人瞩目的性能，但其在恶劣条件下的复杂场景中认知可靠性会显著下降。在这些环境中，模型往往在缺乏充分视觉证据的情况下依赖隐式推理，导致感知与推理之间的脱节。同时，现有的面向结果的基准仅评估最终预测结果，无法诊断底层推理过程中的失败。为弥补这一空白，作者提出了 AD2-Bench，该基准引入了分层视觉诊断框架，将推理分解为结构化的证据链。这种细粒度的诊断揭示了稳健的多模态推理从根本上依赖于准确的证据获取。基于这一视角，作者从概率角度对推理进行建模，并识别出推理失败的两大主要原因。
tldr: 该论文提出 AD2-Bench，通过将多模态推理分解为结构化证据链的分层视觉诊断框架，从概率视角揭示复杂城市场景中模型推理失败主要源于证据获取不准确，从而实现对推理过程而非仅最终结果的细粒度可信评估。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes AD2-Bench, a benchmark with a hierarchical visual diagnosis framework that decomposes multimodal reasoning into a structured Chain of Evidence, revealing from a probabilistic perspective that reasoning failures in complex urban scenes fundamentally stem from inaccurate evidence acquisition.
